name: Liquid pour transition

source.description: Genre convention: food and beverage advertising where a pour or splash fills the frame and becomes the next shot.

technique: A wavy liquid surface rises to cover the frame, then either drains away or becomes the next scene's background.

decomposition.timing: 1.0-1.6 s; ease in on the rise

licensing_notes: Technique only. No specific artwork, footage, characters or compositions from any source are copied.
